limitations: This PMID source audit is fully read and all11 alternate packets are adjudicated; it does not establish completion of the broader source audit. It is post-inference, non-blinded and source correspondence only, not clinical truth or treatment validation.

Internal source conflicts are retained. Table1 third-column header and pp9/12 molecular text support10 n.64_65insT carriers and1 n.69C>T carrier, while the table footnote names the SNV for the10-person column. Main pp9/12 labels the SNV Patient4; SupplementaryTable F3/M3 assigns insertion to4 and SNV to11. No relabelling or silent repair.

Figure1/2 captions label P7 at19years whereas Table1 footnote and SupplementaryTable I8 give13months. Figure2 foot-edema label P1 differs from worksheet P2. MRI captions and worksheet disagree on several individual findings. Exact-person figure linkage remains qualified/unresolved where applicable.

Narrative/Table1/worksheet counts differ (including birth microcephaly, absent speech, growth, hypotelorism, strabismus, autism and osteoporosis). Aggregate statements do not override individual cells; conflicting evidence is retained per assertion.

Source C2:E2 says GRCh38 genomic insT, while frozen packet genomic/VCF descriptors insert A. Source NR_003137.2 versus packet .3, and GRCh37 versus GRCh38 coordinates elsewhere, remain explicit; no independent sequence-version/liftover proof or per-person zygosity trace is available in this paper.

Raw molecular records are available upon author request per p12; none requested. Reported de novo segregation and source pathogenicity labels are not independently reclassified. P5 HERC2 VUS pair and P8 ATRX-containing deletion remain causal alternatives/caveats.
